## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta is a Mahāyāna sūtra on the doctrine of *fǎ jiè tǐ xìng* 法界體性 (the *body-nature of the dharma-realm*) — i.e. the foundational nature of the *dharma-dhātu*. The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta's Suí-imperial-bureau activity (587 – 600 CE).

The Taishō text (T0355) is established on the standard apparatus.
